units: Fractions of stature H. Y up, the figure faces +Z, figure-left = +X. Rest pose: standing, arms hanging, palms forward. Every bone's rest frame is world aligned; _l bones are mirrored to _r automatically.
sources: Segment lengths: Drillis & Contini / Winter Fig 4.1 (research.json stack.segment_proportions). SC (suprasternale) raised to 0.828H after de Leva.

grip.note: Grip centre of the fist relative to the wrist (hand bone origin), hand-local rest axes, H units. The fist is sculpted around a tunnel along hand-local +X through this point, so a handle placed here passes through the curled fingers, not the back of the hand.

sole.note: Foot contact points relative to the ankle (foot bone origin), foot-local rest axes, H units. The sole plane is foot-local y = -0.039.

rom.note: AAOS normal ROM with a small margin (degrees). Checked by verify.mjs on the anatomical read-back.

landmarks.note: Named rest-pose points on bones for pins and contacts: [bone, [x, y, z]] in H.
